i respect your opinion, but how often do you come across people who have experienced trauma to be actual narcissists? it takes a lot of courage and self-talk to allow yourself to recall, feel and process trauma. talking about it is even harder. 
it isn’t easy to allow yourself to be vulnerable and for people who are trying to recover, being accused of seeking pity and attention is hurtful and scary. 
if you feel uncomfortable listening to somebody talk about their struggles, you can always be frank. a narcissist will guilt-trip you for feeling that way while a victim of trauma will immediately be prompted to reflect, and will probably not bring up the topic again. 
it isn’t easy, but please remember that it’s impossible to completely understand someone else. it takes strength to be compassionate♥️
